warnings.label: River Maun in Nottinghamshire
warnings.message:
Forecast high river levels overnight may lead to flooding. 
Flooding is possible on 04 September 2026  
Areas most at risk are low-lying agricultural land and roads around Mansfield, the Sherwood Forest Caravan Park at Clipstone, Edwinstowe, Ollerton, Whitewater Lane at Whitewater Bridge and West Drayton. Heavy rainfall is forecast overnight. River levels at Mansfield The Dykes Gauge will begin rising from 23:30 on 03/09/2026. 
We are closely monitoring the situation  
Take care and avoid walking, cycling or driving through flood water  
This message will be updated by 9:00AM on 04 September 2026 or as the situation changes.
